owner_authorized_time_window.meaning: owner signed the UserOperation to authorize it only during a specific validUntil/validAfter time window
owner_authorized_time_window.checkpoint: before relayer modification of the signature suffix

relayer_holds_signed_userop.meaning: a relayer or observer holds a valid signed UserOperation
relayer_holds_signed_userop.checkpoint: before relayer modification of the signature suffix

suffix_unauthenticated.meaning: the trailing 12-byte validUntil||validAfter suffix of the 77-byte signature is not authenticated by the signer
suffix_unauthenticated.checkpoint: before relayer modification of the signature suffix

time_based_authorization_broken.meaning: time-based authorization guarantees are broken: the owner's intended validUntil/validAfter window no longer constrains execution of the signed UserOperation
time_based_authorization_broken.checkpoint: after relayer submission of the modified UserOperation

assumptions: The relayer needs no on-chain role beyond holding the valid signed UserOperation.
The owner's signed UserOperation is the only prior state; no earlier on-chain transaction is established.
Concrete validUntil/validAfter numeric bounds are not stated and are treated symbolically.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete validUntil/validAfter values or window bounds; the temporal relation is kept symbolic.
Report does not state whether the relayer requires any on-chain permission beyond holding the signed UserOperation.

limitations: Only the breaks_time_based_authorization impact is formalized; other listed impacts are out of scope for this pass.
The temporal relation is expressed over report-grounded Boolean observables because no concrete timestamps are supplied.
Code-level binding of the 77-byte signature layout and suffix handling is deferred.
